description: 象马对王-L1 演示②：深色格象逼入h8深色角落

intro.popup_en: The bishop's color determines the target corner. In this example, the dark-squared bishop and the king and knight coordinate to drive the black king to the dark corner on h8.
intro.popup:
💡 深色格象示例
象的颜色决定要逼入哪个角落！

outro.popup_en: Ng5 is checkmate in the h8 corner. The bishop's color determines the mating corner: a dark-squared bishop drives the king to h8, while a light-squared bishop targets h1.
outro.popup: ✅ Ng5# — 绝杀！深色象→h8角！象的颜色=目标角落的颜色！

moves.popup_en: 1. Be7: the dark-squared bishop moves from f8 to e7 and begins coordinating with the king and knight to drive the black king toward h8.
moves.popup: 🔄 1.Be7 — 深色象从f8移至e7，开始协调王和马向h8发起逼迫。

moves.popup_en: The black king retreats toward the h-file.
moves.popup: ↓ Kh6 — 黑王向h路退缩。

moves.popup_en: 2. Kf4: the white king approaches the center and prepares to block the h-file escape.
moves.popup: ♔ 2.Kf4 — 白王向中心逼近，准备封锁h路逃跑。

moves.popup_en: The black king struggles to resist.
moves.popup: ↓ Kg6 — 黑王挣扎。

moves.popup_en: 3. Ke4: the white king makes a waiting move.
moves.popup: ♔ 3.Ke4 — 白王等了一步。

moves.popup_en: The black king keeps maneuvering around the g- and h-files.
moves.popup: ↓ Kg7 — 黑王继续在g、h路徘徊。

moves.popup_en: 4. Kf5: the white king begins driving the black king, controlling key squares around g4, g5, g6, h4, and h5.
moves.popup: ♔ 4.Kf5 — 白王到f5，开始逼迫黑王。

moves.popup_en: The black king moves along the h-file and tries to escape.
moves.popup: ↓ Kh6 — 黑王沿h路移动，试图逃出。

moves.popup_en: 5. Ne6: the knight prepares to join the encirclement and controls several escape squares.
moves.popup: ⭐ 5.Ne6 — 马准备加入包围。

moves.popup_en: The black king is still trying to escape.
moves.popup: ↓ Kh5 — 黑王还在试图逃脱。

moves.popup_en: 6. Nf4+ checks and brings the knight into the net.
moves.popup: ⭐ 6.Nf4+ — 将军！马加入包围！

moves.popup_en: This is the only legal move for the black king.
moves.popup: ↓ Kh6 — 唯一合法走法！）

moves.popup_en: 7. Kf6: the white king advances toward h8 and controls the g7 escape square.
moves.popup: ♔ 7.Kf6 — 白王直逼h8方向，封锁g7出口！

moves.popup_en: The black king retreats along the h-file, gradually being driven toward the corner.
moves.popup: ↓ Kh7 — 黑王沿h路后退，逐渐被逼向角落。

moves.popup_en: 8. Bf8: the bishop tightens the blockade and controls g7 and h6.
moves.popup: 🔄 <b>8.Bf8 — 象进一步封锁！

moves.popup_en: The black king is forced into the dark corner on h8. This is the only move.
moves.popup: ↓ <b>Kh8 — 黑王退入深色角落h8！是唯一选择！

moves.popup_en: 9. Kf7: the white king controls g8. From h8, the black king has only h7 available.
moves.popup:
♔ 9.Kf7 — 白王到f7，封死g8！
黑王在h8只剩h7可走。

moves.popup_en: Forced: the black king can only move to h7.
moves.popup: ↓ Kh7 — 被迫！只能走h7。

moves.popup_en: 10. Nh3 repositions the knight for the final mate, preparing Ng5 to control h7.
moves.popup:
⭐ 10.Nh3 — 马重新定位，准备最终将杀！
马从f4跳到h3，准备Ng5——届时将控制h7！

moves.popup_en: The black king returns to the corner and tries to resist.
moves.popup: ↓ Kh8 — 黑王回到角落；试图抵抗。

moves.popup_en: 11. Bg7+ checks directly against the king on h8. The black king must go to h7 because Kf7 controls g8.
moves.popup:
⭐ 11.Bg7+ — 象将军！
象从f8跳到g7，直接将军h8！
黑王只能逃往h7（g8=白王Kf7封死）。

moves.popup_en: Forced: g8 is controlled by the white king, so the black king must go to h7.
moves.popup: ↓ Kh7 — 被迫！g8=Kf7，只能去h7。

moves.popup_en: Ng5 is checkmate. The white king controls g6 and g8, the bishop occupies g7 and attacks h6 and h8, and the knight checks the king on h7. A dark-squared bishop leads to the h8 corner, just as a light-squared bishop leads to h1.
moves.popup:
🏁 Ng5# — 将死！深色象→h8角完成！
马从h3跃至g5将死h7：
• g6 → 白王Kf7控制
• g7 → 象Bg7占据
• g8 → 白王Kf7控制
• h6 → 象Bg7攻击(g7→h6 ✓)
• h8 → 象Bg7攻击(g7→h8 ✓)
对称之美：深色象→h8 = 浅色象→h1！
